experiment: ECONINTEL Inflation Structural Proxy Nowcast v0.1
source: CI diagnostic preview, values rounded to three decimals as printed in GitHub Actions log
officialDataSource: BLS CPI October 2026 release; FRED latest observations captured on Nov 28

model.cpi: BLS Sep 2026 expenditure relative-importance weights across food, energy, core goods, shelter and core services. EIA gasoline trend for energy CPI
model.ppi: Experimental 50/50 PPI 3-month momentum vs Brent-price historical proxy
model.pce: Historical ridge relationship using estimated CPI and PPI November and previous PCE observations

caveats: This is a research trial output, NOT verified predictive accuracy and not a trading signal.
2026-11 gasoline/Brent monthly observations are partial; final monthly means may differ.
CPI category weighted contributions are first-order approximations and not exact BLS aggregation.
YoY estimates use seasonally adjusted index levels and can differ from official non-seasonally adjusted BLS figures.
PPI uses no official PPI expenditure weights and PCE is not reconstructed from BEA component expenditure shares.
Each estimate requires retrospective point-in-time backtesting and dated market consensus to establish predictive value.
